description.text: An enhanced expansion pack released on 19 January 2018 in which Naganadel-GX leads an army of Ultra Beasts. Naganadel-GX's attack Beast Raid grows with the number of Ultra Beasts in play, and its GX attack resets both players to three Prize cards. Ultra Beasts also arrived as ordinary Pokémon for the first time, among them Dusk Mane Necrozma and Dawn Wings Necrozma, with Beast Energy, a Prism Star Energy, and Trainers made for them; Palkia-GX, Dialga-GX, Lucario-GX and Arceus Prism Star join them. Every card is holo, and each pack held five, one of them a basic Energy. The cards are numbered to 50, followed by full-art Super Rare Pokémon-GX, Ultra Recon Squad and Crasher Wake, rainbow Hyper Rare Pokémon-GX, gold Ultra Rare Energy Recycler, Beast Ring and Metal Frying Pan, and the holo basic Energy. In English its cards were split between Ultra Prism and Forbidden Light in 2018.
